Function Report(p As PivotTable) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim c As Range,s As String
s=p.Name & ":cache=" & p.CacheIndex & ":range=" & p.TableRange1.Address & ":cells="
For Each c In p.TableRange1.Cells
s=s & c.Address(False,False) & ":" & TypeName(c.Value2) & ":" & CStr(c.Value2) & "|"
Next
Report=s
Exit Function
Failed:
Report=s & "ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function SourceValues() As String
Dim c As Range,s As String
For Each c In Worksheets("Data").Range("B2:B6").Cells
On Error Resume Next
Err.Clear
s=s & c.Address(False,False) & ":" & TypeName(c.Value2) & ":" & CStr(c.Value2) & "|"
If Err.Number<>0 Then s=s & "ERR:" & Err.Number & "|"
On Error GoTo 0
Next
SourceValues=s
End Function
Function Snapshot() As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim ws As Worksheet
Set ws=Worksheets("Data")
Snapshot="mode=" & Application.Calculation & ":source=" & SourceValues() & ";" & Report(ws.PivotTables("First")) & ";" & Report(ws.PivotTables("Shared")) & ";" & Report(ws.PivotTables("Unrelated"))
Exit Function
Failed:
Snapshot="SNAPSHOT-ERROR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Attempt(c As PivotCache,p As PivotTable) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim v As Boolean
c.Refresh
Attempt="completed"
Exit Function
Failed:
Attempt="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet,c As PivotCache,u As PivotCache,p As PivotTable,q As PivotTable,z As PivotTable,f As PivotField,s As String,stage As String
Dim sink As New RefreshEventSink
On Error GoTo Failed
stage="setup"
Application.EnableEvents=False
Application.Calculation=-4105
Set ws=ActiveSheet
ws.Name="Data"
ws.Range("A1:C1").Value=Array("Region","Amount","Input")
ws.Range("A2:C2").Value=Array("East",0,1)
ws.Range("A3:C3").Value=Array("West",0,2)
ws.Range("A4:C4").Value=Array("East",0,3)
ws.Range("A5:C5").Value=Array("West",0,4)
ws.Range("A6:C6").Value=Array("East",0,5)
ws.Range("B2:B6").FormulaR1C1="=RC[1]*10"
ws.Range("J1:K1").Value=Array("Other","Amount")
ws.Range("J2:K2").Value=Array("X",7)
ws.Range("J3:K3").Value=Array("Y",8)
ws.Range("A:O").ColumnWidth=18
Set c=ThisWorkbook.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase,ws.Range("A1:C6"))
Set p=c.CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("E3"),"First")
Set f=p.AddDataField(p.PivotFields("Amount"),"Total",xlSum)
Set q=c.CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("G3"),"Shared")

Set f=q.AddDataField(q.PivotFields("Amount"),"Mean",xlAverage)
Set u=ThisWorkbook.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase,ws.Range("J1:K3"))
Set z=u.CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("M3"),"Unrelated")
Set f=z.AddDataField(z.PivotFields("Amount"),"OtherTotal",xlSum)
Application.Calculation=-4105
s="initial=[" & Snapshot() & "]"
ws.Range("C2").Value2=10
ws.Range("C6").Value2=50
ws.Range("K2").Value2=70
s=s & ";edited=[" & Snapshot() & "]"
Set sink.Ws=ws
sink.RaiseOnPivot=False
Application.EnableEvents=True
stage="refresh"
s=s & ";refresh=" & Attempt(c,p)

Application.EnableEvents=False
Set sink.Ws=Nothing
Application.Calculation=-4105
Probe=s
Exit Function
Failed:
s=s & ";PROBE-ERROR:" & stage & ":" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description

Set sink.Ws=Nothing
Application.Calculation=-4105

Function Report(p As PivotTable) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim c As Range,s As String
s=p.Name & ":cache=" & p.CacheIndex & ":range=" & p.TableRange1.Address & ":cells="
For Each c In p.TableRange1.Cells
s=s & c.Address(False,False) & ":" & TypeName(c.Value2) & ":" & CStr(c.Value2) & "|"
Next
Report=s
Exit Function
Failed:
Report=s & "ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function SourceValues() As String
Dim c As Range,s As String
For Each c In Worksheets("Data").Range("B2:B6").Cells
On Error Resume Next
Err.Clear
s=s & c.Address(False,False) & ":" & TypeName(c.Value2) & ":" & CStr(c.Value2) & "|"
If Err.Number<>0 Then s=s & "ERR:" & Err.Number & "|"
On Error GoTo 0
Next
SourceValues=s
End Function
Function Snapshot() As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim ws As Worksheet
Set ws=Worksheets("Data")
Snapshot="mode=" & Application.Calculation & ":source=" & SourceValues() & ";" & Report(ws.PivotTables("First")) & ";" & Report(ws.PivotTables("Shared")) & ";" & Report(ws.PivotTables("Unrelated"))
Exit Function
Failed:
Snapshot="SNAPSHOT-ERROR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Attempt(c As PivotCache,p As PivotTable) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim v As Boolean
c.Refresh
Attempt="completed"
Exit Function
Failed:
Attempt="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet,c As PivotCache,u As PivotCache,p As PivotTable,q As PivotTable,z As PivotTable,f As PivotField,s As String,stage As String
Dim sink As New RefreshEventSink
On Error GoTo Failed
stage="setup"
Application.EnableEvents=False
Application.Calculation=-4105
Set ws=ActiveSheet
ws.Name="Data"
ws.Range("A1:C1").Value=Array("Region","Amount","Input")
ws.Range("A2:C2").Value=Array("East",0,1)
ws.Range("A3:C3").Value=Array("West",0,2)
ws.Range("A4:C4").Value=Array("East",0,3)
ws.Range("A5:C5").Value=Array("West",0,4)
ws.Range("A6:C6").Value=Array("East",0,5)
ws.Range("B2:B6").FormulaR1C1="=RC[1]*10"
ws.Range("J1:K1").Value=Array("Other","Amount")
ws.Range("J2:K2").Value=Array("X",7)
ws.Range("J3:K3").Value=Array("Y",8)
ws.Range("A:O").ColumnWidth=18
Set c=ThisWorkbook.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase,ws.Range("A1:C6"))
Set p=c.CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("E3"),"First")

Set f=q.AddDataField(q.PivotFields("Amount"),"Mean",xlAverage)
Set u=ThisWorkbook.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase,ws.Range("J1:K3"))
Set z=u.CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("M3"),"Unrelated")
Set f=z.AddDataField(z.PivotFields("Amount"),"OtherTotal",xlSum)
Application.Calculation=-4135
s="initial=[" & Snapshot() & "]"

ws.Range("K2").Value2=70
s=s & ";edited=[" & Snapshot() & "]"
Set sink.Ws=ws
sink.RaiseOnPivot=False
Application.EnableEvents=True
stage="refresh"
s=s & ";refresh=" & Attempt(c,p)

Application.EnableEvents=False
Set sink.Ws=Nothing
Application.Calculation=-4105
Probe=s

Failed:
s=s & ";PROBE-ERROR:" & stage & ":" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description

Set sink.Ws=Nothing
Application.Calculation=-4105
